data.one_liner: A pure Dart/Flutter offline OCR library for extracting text from clean digital images.
data.what_it_does: Extracts text from clean digital images using standard fonts entirely offline with no external native dependencies. It includes optional English dictionary correction and configurable matching options.
use_when: You need offline OCR for clean digital images across multiple platforms
You want to avoid native C/C++ compilation or heavy external dependencies for text extraction
avoid_when: You need to process handwritten text, complex backgrounds, or noisy documents
You are processing non-English text with dictionary correction enabled
strengths: 100% offline with zero external native dependencies
Cross-platform support (Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web)
Configurable presets for speed, accuracy, and robust processing
weaknesses: Limited character set and English-only dictionary correction support
Fails with handwritten text, low-resolution inputs, or noisy backgrounds
Plain text only with no styling preservation
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions or build_runner steps required.
